Jessica woke up at 6am.
Lisa saw Jessica waiting at the train station from 6am to 12pm.

The restaurant was closed after 7pm.
Between what times could Jessica have gone to the restaurant?

Options:
(A) 6pm to 7pm
(B) 6am to 12pm
(C) 12pm to 2pm
(D) 2pm to 6pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)
